settings.heading: THE NEW SEASON
settings.subheading: Tailored silhouettes, natural fibres, and considered colour — a collection built for women who dress with intention, not for trends that fade by spring.

settings.quote: We don't design for a season. We design pieces you'll still be reaching for in five years.

settings.heading: Four categories, one point of view
Crafted in small batches, built to last seasons
settings.body: Founded in 2014, Velora began as a two-person atelier focused on a single idea: clothing should be made from real materials, cut with real tailoring, and sold without the churn of fast fashion. Today we work with a small number of European mills and Indian ateliers to produce considered collections twice a year.
